title: Choose the homepage structure
question: Three compositions for the Quiet Gallery. The roll assigned The Focused Plinth.

options.label: The Focused Plinth
options.thesis: A stark, ultra-minimal hero showing only the single most recent piece of work.
options.viewport: Full viewport dedicated to one featured piece (poem, essay, art) with subtle navigation below.
options.risk: Requires strong daily or weekly curation to remain fresh.

options.label: The Index
options.thesis: A dense, typography-driven list view grouped by year, resembling an academic journal table of contents.
options.viewport: A rigorous chronological index of all work, text-heavy and scannable.
options.risk: Visual art is deemphasized in favor of reading flow.

options.label: The Split Canvas
options.thesis: A fixed typographic bio on the left, and a scrollable feed of chronological updates on the right.
options.viewport: Two clear columns: identity anchored on the left, fresh content scrolling on the right.
options.risk: Can feel slightly more conventional than a pure reading layout.
